content:
We need DBE for C15H22S. DBE formula: DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 +1 (ignoring halogens). For heteroatoms like S, O, etc., they don't affect DBE. No N. So DBE = 15 - 22/2 + 1 = 15 - 11 + 1 = 5. So integer 5.

We could retrieve formula via tool but we know. Might still call retrieve_dbe_formula to be safe. Use tool.
